name: Avocadio
tagline: AI video maker for short cinematic clips
description: Avocadio is an AI video creation app for short cinematic clips. Describe a scene with Text to Video, or start from a still with Image to Video. Use starter prompts and templates to fill direction faster, generate a preview, then revisit outputs in history as you iterate with credits. Built for social-ready shorts and promo-style visuals—not a full multi-track timeline editor. Publisher: Aqua Lotus Partners Ltd. Web app live at avocadio.ai; iOS and Android apps submitted and awaiting store approval. Blog guides: blog.avocadio.ai.
